batch: Resolve TMH 7 from the official Library of Congress catalog record
policy: Supersedes the earlier unresolved decision. The series number is explicit official bibliographic evidence, not inference; object-level readings remain unchecked.

entries.basis: Library of Congress LCCN 2006364726 explicitly identifies Christa Müller-Kessler's 2005 Harrassowitz volume as Texte und Materialien der Frau Professor Hilprecht Collection of Babylonian Antiquities im Eigentum der Universität Jena, Bd. 7. This resolves TMH 7 to SRC-63345F60155B and supersedes IBI-PUBREG-18.
